style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red.
avoid_en: logos or emblems of real companies or government agencies, readable text, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people, guns pointed at the viewer

chapo.desc_en: the drug lord, a short stocky faceless man figurine in his fifties with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short black hair, a thick black mustache shape, plain black baseball cap without any logo, plain dark-blue button shirt, dark jeans

tech.desc_en: the technician, a slim faceless young man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short neat brown hair, thin black-rimmed glasses, plain light-blue shirt without any print, gray trousers

marines.desc_en: marine figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain dark gray-green uniforms with no patches, flags or letters, plain black helmets, weapons always pointed down

cuts.image: 白い空間に、黒い携帯の模型の画面が窓になっていて、その奥からいくつもの小さな目の形の赤い光がこちらを見ている
cuts.image_en: A large plain black phone model standing in the white space whose screen is an open window; from inside the window several small red eye-shaped lights look outward. Symbolic, eerie.
cuts.en: A large plain black phone model standing in the white space whose screen is an open window; from inside the window several small red eye-shaped lights look outward. Symbolic, eerie.

cuts.en: A broken network of red lines hanging loose in the white space, several plain black phones lying scattered on the floor below. Abandoned mood.
